title: 第一卷 第340章 男龙低头咬住了她的耳垂第一卷 第339章 真敏感差点又被你亲到了
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
舒晩昭发现这两天大龙特别爱较真儿。
她一心搞“事业”，整天忙得到处叉人，大龙倒好，三天打鱼两天晒网地填补龙族秘境，剩下的时间都用来缠着她。
说什么要给她当项链，舒晩昭都有些后悔之前让大龙当项链了，这条龙特别霸道，还咬碎了她好几枚项链，就是为了给他腾位置。
她骂骂咧咧地将龙赶跑，男人懒散地伸了个懒腰，那张俊到超出三界之外的帅逼脸，流露出威风凛凛的睥睨表情，“赶我走？行啊，你别后悔呦~”
那模样，仿佛他走了就不会再回来一样。
看着他离开的背影，舒晩昭的心头一紧，刚要上前两步，却见前方的他变成烟雾飘散，她的耳朵处传来冰凉的气息，“人类，我说过，你别后悔。”
下一秒，她的耳朵一痛，男龙低头，艳鬼似的薄唇轻启，咬住了她的耳垂，狠狠一口，疼得她倒吸了一口凉气。
反手就要去打他，他却来了个蛇皮走位，黑色的头发无拘无束地披散在身后，头顶上的两只龙角霸气威严，唯独那张男妖精的脸，眼波流转尽是邪气，他用拇指抵住了唇瓣，低声评价，“味道也就那样吧。”
有点软，有点香，但不能吃，最终评价，一般。
也不知道另一个他为什么一直惦记。
嗯，是小龙想吃了，不是他大龙想吃。
【天杀的……】
舒晩昭气炸了，拿出三叉戟一抛，下一秒他已经哼哼哼地离开，“我去填补入口咯，你可不许偷懒。”
他还有脸说。
舒晩昭原地跳脚，“臭东西，到底谁偷懒，你看我下次看见你乱跑打不打你。”
远方，传来男子靡靡之音，“是吗？可吓死我了。”
就仗着他有点身法这么欺负她。
舒晩昭吭哧吭哧把插在地上的小叉子捡起来，爬上巨兽的后背，雄赳赳气昂昂地出发，有使不完的精力叉人。
有大龙给的法器，大乘期以下，包括化神期她统统都能叉出去，根本不费力，然而今日下午，和大龙分开不久，舒晩昭就踢到了铁板，一叉子过去，秘境入口中冷不丁出现一把重剑。
重剑通体黝黑，泛着浩瀚的金色纹路，上面散发的金色剑气，光看一眼都会觉得一阵头晕目眩。

一剑一叉两者相撞，发出一声沉重的撞击声。
三叉戟脱手而出，在半空中划过凄凄惨惨的弧度，叮地一下就穿在了地上，震得尘土飞扬。
舒晩昭也被这道力量震飞出去。
她和三叉戟一起起飞的，在半空中转圈圈，可是还没等落地，就被一只非常有力，带有剥茧的手，牢牢地扣住了柔软的腰肢。
一下子就“着陆”了。
舒晩昭的小心脏狂跳，她疯狂拍着自己的小心脏，生怕对方一不小心离家出走，等安抚好了乱蹦的心脏，突然意识到事情的不简单。
她……好像在谁的怀里。
熟悉之中又有几分陌生的冷冽气息，后腰是一只有力的大手，轻而易举将她单手抱起，另一只手还拿着他的剑，她一抬头，就对上一双阴沉沉的眸子。
对于舒晩昭来说是十五年，外界的其他人却是真正的过了百年。
百年后的小古板，锋芒更加逼人，那双黑眸眼底仿佛藏了无尽的深渊，光是看一眼就容易被吸进去的那种。
他比以前更加强壮了，宽阔的胸膛，劲壮的公狗腰，小说男主的建模脸，深邃的五官剑眉星目，乍一抬眸，还是很有冲击感的。
而他看着自己的眼神，明明没有说话，却胜似千言万语，深邃幽深还有几分苦涩。
男人抿紧唇瓣，喉结滚动，酝酿了许久，喉咙紧绷的难受，嘴巴仿佛灌满了水泥，愣是说不出来一个字。
曾经他初出茅庐，挑战前辈的时候会说三个字：请赐教。
等他成为剑尊之后，就再也没有开口说过一句话。
以至于，他早就忘记如何开口与人说话。
他们这几个人都从师尊那里知道师妹被一条龙带走了，那条龙……百年前他在卧龙宗见过。
师尊说，那条龙目前可以保护好小师妹，所有才任由那条龙把师妹带走。
师妹现在是天道重点击杀对象。
可是，百年了啊。

没有人知道这百年他是怎么过的。
师妹的离去，让他回归曾经的生活。
以往的乐于练剑，都变得无趣了起来，但是师妹需要他的问心剑，那么他就练。
content_en:
Shu Mingzhao found that Dalong especially loved Zhener in the past two days.
She was focused on her "career" and was busy stabbing people all day long. Dalong was better, spending three days fishing and two days drying nets to fill the secret realm of the dragon clan. The rest of the time was spent pestering her.
Talking about giving her a necklace, Shu Mingzhao regretted letting Dalong act as a necklace before. This dragon was very overbearing and even chewed up several of her necklaces, just to make room for him.
She cursed and drove the dragon away, and the man stretched lazily, with a majestic look on his handsome face that transcended the Three Realms, "Drive me away? Okay, don't regret it~"
It looked like he would never come back after leaving.
Watching his leaving figure, Shu Minzhao's heart tightened. Just as she was about to take two steps forward, she saw him in front of him turning into smoke and drifting away. A cold breath came from her ears, "Human, I said, don't regret it."
The next second, her ears hurt. The male dragon lowered his head, opened his thin lips like a naughty ghost, bit her earlobe, and gave her a sharp bite, which made her gasp in pain.
He was about to hit him with his backhand, but he made a snake-skin move. His black hair was hanging freely behind him, and the two dragon horns on his head were domineering and majestic. Only the face of the male goblin, whose eyes were full of evil. He put his thumb against his lips and commented in a low voice, "It tastes just like that."
A little soft, a little fragrant, but inedible. The final evaluation is average.
He doesn't know why he keeps thinking about the other one.
Well, it was the little dragon who wanted to eat it, not the big dragon.
【Damn it...】
Shu Mingzhao was so angry that he took out his trident and threw it. The next second he left with a groan, "I'm going to fill the entrance. You can't be lazy."
He still had the nerve to say it.
Shu Minzhao jumped on the spot, "You bastard, who is lazy? You see if I will hit you next time I see you running around."
In the distance, a man's voice sounded, "Really? It scared me to death."
He bullied her just because he had some skills.
Shu Zhaozhao picked up the small fork stuck in the ground, climbed on the back of the giant beast, and set off boldly, with endless energy to fork people.
With the magic weapon given by Da Long, she could fork out everything below the Mahayana stage, including the stage of transformation, without any effort at all. However, this afternoon, shortly after leaving Da Long, Shu Mizhao kicked the iron plate, and with one fork, a heavy sword suddenly appeared at the entrance of the secret realm.
The heavy sword is completely black, with vast golden lines, and the golden sword energy emanating from it will make you feel dizzy just by looking at it.
A sword and a fork collided with each other, making a heavy impact sound.
The trident came out of his hand, making a miserable arc in mid-air, and pierced the ground with a clang, causing dust to fly.
Shu Mingzhao was also blown away by this power.
She took off with the trident, spinning in circles in mid-air, but before she could land, a very strong, calloused hand clasped her soft waist firmly.
I "landed" right away.
Shu Mingzhao's little heart was beating wildly. She patted her own little heart frantically, fearing that the other party would accidentally run away from home. After calming her racing heart, she suddenly realized that things were not simple.
She... seemed to be in someone's arms.
There was a cold aura that was both familiar and unfamiliar, and there was a strong big hand on her back, easily picking her up with one hand, and holding his sword in the other hand. When she raised her head, she met a pair of gloomy eyes.
For Shu Mingzhao, it was fifteen years, but for others in the outside world, it had truly been a hundred years.
A hundred years later, the little old-fashioned person has an even sharper edge. There seems to be an endless abyss hidden in those black eyes, the kind that can easily be sucked in just by looking at them.
He is stronger than before, with a broad chest, a strong male waist, a face modeled after the hero of the novel, and deep facial features, sharp eyebrows and starry eyes. When he first looks up, he still has a strong sense of impact.of.
And the way he looked at her, even though he didn't speak, was worth a thousand words, deep and a bit bitter.
The man pursed his lips tightly and his Adam's apple rolled. It had been brewing for a long time. His throat was tense and uncomfortable, and his mouth seemed to be filled with cement. He was speechless and could not say a word.
When he was just starting out, he would say three words when challenging his seniors: Please teach me.
After he became the Sword Master, he never spoke a word again.
So much so that he had long forgotten how to speak to others.
They all knew from their master that the junior sister was taken away by a dragon. That dragon... he had seen it in the Wolong Sect a hundred years ago.
The master said that the dragon could protect the little junior sister, so he allowed the dragon to take the junior sister away.
Junior sister is now the target of Tiandao's heavy attack.
But, it’s been a hundred years.
No one knows how he lived these hundred years.
The departure of his junior sister made him return to his old life.
The joy of practicing swords in the past has become boring, but if the junior sister needs his Wenxin Sword, then he will practice it.
